nodes.label: Goal Anchor
nodes.summary: Stores the stable original project objective used as the reference point for later questions.

nodes.label: Baseline Structure
nodes.summary: Preserves the first coherent project structure so future changes can be compared against it.

nodes.label: Codex Wrapper
nodes.summary: Acts as the gateway that logs a question, loads direction context, prepares Codex context, and records outcomes.

nodes.label: Question Log
nodes.summary: Append-only log of meaningful user questions with stable ids and raw text.

nodes.label: Impact Analyzer
nodes.summary: Classifies whether a question is tactical, structural, direction-changing, drifting, conflicting, clarifying, or evidential.

nodes.label: Mental Model Delta
nodes.summary: Small explainable updates that record how a new question changes or strengthens the current model.

nodes.label: Context Capsule
nodes.summary: Compact project-direction context injected into Codex-facing work.

nodes.label: Mindmap Visualization
nodes.summary: Renders the current mental model, source questions, and recent deltas as a graph.

nodes.label: LLM Wiki Contrast
nodes.summary: Clarifies that the product tracks project direction changes, not just stored information retrieval.

nodes.label: Open Decisions
nodes.summary: Tracks unresolved product and architecture choices such as interface, storage, renderer, Codex integration depth, and compaction cadence.

nodes.label: External Runtime
nodes.summary: Supports using the wrapper outside the local browser by running a small local service or packaged desktop runtime that owns the .mental store and Codex task boundary.

nodes.label: Electron Shell
nodes.summary: Packages the mindmap UI and local wrapper service into a desktop app that can stay open without relying on a browser tab.

nodes.label: Codex Execution Adapter
nodes.summary: Defines how prepared context capsules are handed to Codex CLI/API and how outcomes return to the mental model logs.

nodes.label: Installable Codex-like CLI
nodes.summary: The product should be installable like Codex and expose a command that opens or attaches to a project workspace.

nodes.label: Mindmap-first Launch
nodes.summary: Running the installed wrapper should open the project mindmap first, making the current mental model the default surface before development continues.

nodes.label: Development Activity Capture
nodes.summary: Codex-like development actions should feed question logs, decisions, outcomes, and model deltas so the mindmap is drawn as work happens.

nodes.label: Question Direction Directive
nodes.summary: Captures explicit # directives before Codex questions so the user controls whether a task is directionless, weakly structural, strongly directional, boundary-setting, conflicting, drifting, or evidential.

nodes.label: Project Workspace Analysis
nodes.summary: goal-graph: Monorepo, Node.js, TypeScript; source directories: apps, packages, tests; docs: AGENTS.md, README.md, package.json.

nodes.label: Terminal Session Runtime
nodes.summary: Running the installed command without a subcommand opens the current workspace, asks for consent if needed, analyzes the project, then keeps a terminal prompt for questions, mode changes, sync, and exit.

edges.summary: The current thesis must stay comparable to the original Goal Anchor.

The visible mindmap reflects the current model and recent direction deltas.
